# GKPATH: Set up
env GK111MODULE=off

# GKPATH: Fetch with insecure, should error
! go get -insecure test
stderr 'gecko: -insecure flag is no longer supported; use GKINSECURE instead'

# Modules: Set up
env GK111MODULE=on

# Modules: Fetch with insecure, should error
! go get -insecure test
stderr 'gecko: -insecure flag is no longer supported; use GKINSECURE instead'
